title: Correlation
description: A manual X-matrix cell override (Core Model §05). The X-matrix derives correlations from the graph's links; a Correlation lets a facilitator set an explicit strength on a specific cell (or force it empty). LOCKED addition.

a.description: Source node id (e.g. an initiative or objective).

b.description: Target node id (e.g. an objective, KPI, owner, or goal).
